title: Hot Crispy Algerian Feta Kebabs
description: A quick and crispy Algerian dish featuring cubed feta cheese, render fat, and a binchotan grill, perfect for a keto friendly snack.
instructions: Preheat the binchotan grill to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Thread the cubed feta cheese onto skewers, leaving a small space between each cube.
Brush the render fat onto the feta cheese, making sure each cube is fully coated.
Sprinkle the paprika, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper onto the feta cheese.
Drizzle the lemon juice onto the feta cheese.
Place the skewers onto the preheated grill and cook for 5 minutes per side, or until crispy and golden brown.
Remove the skewers from the grill and garnish with chopped parsley, if desired.
Serve the hot crispy Algerian feta kebabs immediately and enjoy.
